semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact identity, mana cost, Artifact type, three ability definitions and Oracle-line presentation.
Six-mana cast and additive Artifact type for four players' permanents, with Darksteel Forge and source departure.
A land enters as an artifact and triggers Quicksmith Genius.
Cards in several zones, permanents and a token are colorless while Lattice is present.
Physical and copied spells have colorless source qualities for Flashfreeze.
Proposed spell colors and protection-based target legality at resolution.
Already-started type and color effects survive later ability removal.
Song of the Dryads removes the source abilities before their effects apply.
Layer-five color effects respect timestamp order.
An actual top-of-library cast uses a labeled synthetic colorless permission.
Rings retains the exact activated source's departure characteristics.
Actual Library of Leng discard replacement preserves hidden-card information and captures revealed event-time color.
Each player may spend actual blue mana for red spell costs; receipts retain blue.
The permission applies to an activated ability's red mana cost.
A real Flameshadow Conjuring resolution payment and its offer use the live permission.
Restricted mana remains restricted while its color can be used as though another color.
Actual Convoke uses creature contributions for original costs and mana for the remainder.
Mana and creature selections in either order retain a valid Convoke payment.
Actual Waterbend and a labeled synthetic mixed-color cost preserve generic-only taps and off-color mana payment.
A synthetic mixed cost still requires actual colorless mana for {C}.
A synthetic {U}{C} cost can be staged in either order without treating colored mana as {C}.
Actual hybrid and Phyrexian costs retain their mana and life alternatives.
Flame Javelin's mono-hybrid alternatives interact correctly with generic reductions.
A staged payment is checked again after Ironworks removes the last Lattice; a second source retains permission.
A retained off-color debit is cancelled after the source owner's departure.
A naturally legal retained debit survives source departure.
A second surviving Lattice preserves a retained off-color debit.
Accepted wire commands reconstruct cancellation and the subsequent legal action.
Missing permission does not turn an independently stale mana snapshot into accepted cancellation.
A synthetic layer-six removal and restoration affect the live spending permission.
A real Sculpting Steel copy grants spending permission after the original leaves.
Actual Pentad Prism and a labeled synthetic mixed-cost fixture count the colors of mana actually spent.
